comparison.objective: Remove a tagged bin from a gravity lane while restraining the following bin; candidate screens media from finished parts.
comparison.physical_skill: Dynamic interception, temporary restraint, bin extraction, and lane restoration versus bimanual screen manipulation and many-body flow control.
comparison.success_condition: Tagged bin in tote, next bin moves ≤2 cm, remaining lane closes up versus ≥98% media recovered with every washer retained and no spill/damage.
comparison.reason: Both manage gravity-driven objects, but bin-flow control and granular aperture separation are materially different abilities.
